entries.subject: AMICA mosaic
entries.finding: Eight v-band observations from September–October 2005, with [Gaskell-controlled AMICA records](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/pds3/hay-a-amica-3-amicageom-v1.0/), original FITS and preflight flat. The October close-ups add finer terrain detail and views north and south of the equator. Relative detector brightness, not absolute radiance or albedo.

entries.subject: Shape and Elevation
entries.finding: [Gaskell ver128q](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/non_mission/gaskell.ast-itokawa.shape-model/data/vertex/ver128q.tab), derived from 775 AMICA images. Elevation is source radius minus 165 m; the original black-rock prime meridian is retained.

entries.subject: Named features
entries.finding: [IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature](https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Page/ITOKAWA/target) Itokawa centre-point export, snapshot 2026-09-11, public domain. IAU-adopted names with centre, diameter, extent and name origin; labels appear at the closest zoom only, and a selected feature stays labelled.
